mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting blood into the circuit was most worthwhile because it connected the pump and vessels to tissue exchange and the return journey.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the heart into its labeled pump slot was straightforward but offered little uncertainty on its own.

surprise.text: The red blood cells' ability to make ATP from sugar without mitochondria was a useful contrast with muscle cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and named slots gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing how the completed circuit supplies tissues made me curious about how other body systems connect to it.
